name: Singapore

fees.name: Singapore e-Visa (visa-required nationals)
fees.validity: Single or multiple entry, typically issued for up to 2 months; processed within ~3 working days
fees.applies: nationals of visa-required countries (e.g. IND, CHN, and others per ICA schedule)
fees.notes: Non-refundable S$30 processing fee, payable online by Visa/Mastercard credit or debit card. Applies uniformly across visa-required nationalities per ICA guidance; no separate reciprocity schedule found on ICA site.

fees.name: Visa fee via Singapore Overseas Mission / authorised visa agent
fees.applies: visa-required nationals applying in person or via agent rather than e-Visa
fees.notes: ICA confirms the S$30 government fee applies; any additional mission/agent handling charge is not published by ICA and was not verifiable on an official source, so left null rather than estimated.

fees.name: SG Arrival Card (SGAC)
fees.validity: Single arrival; submit within 3 days (including day of arrival) before entry
fees.applies: all travellers (exempt: transit without immigration clearance)
fees.notes: Free digital arrival declaration required of every foreign visitor regardless of visa status; submitted online or via the MyICA app.

vfs.note: Singapore visa applications for most nationalities (including India) are processed through ICA's own e-Service or via authorised local visa agents/Singapore Overseas Missions, not through VFS Global as an official outsourcing partner. No official VFS Global Singapore-outbound visa service page was found confirming VFS as the designated centre for the required nationalities; unverified third-party blog mentions of VFS/agent surcharges (₹300-1500) were excluded as non-official.

free_visa_notes: Singapore grants visa-free entry to most passport holders (including USA, GBR, most EU/Schengen states, many others) for short tourist stays. A visa (S$30 e-Visa fee) is required only for nationals of specific countries per the ICA visa-required list (e.g. India, China, and others). Singapore is not a Schengen member; no Schengen fee applies.
